translation: For the one below, near the abdomen, it is easy to treat by lifting it with the hand, because this rib is near the edge and can be grasped by the hand, so the broken rib can be restored to its position. The person will necessarily lower the head and bend the waist, groaning in pain, and can only lie on the side, not lie on the back; if he stands up, the five viscera all ache, or the head is dizzy and the spirit clouded, and food and drink are taken little. One should administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, wash with Baxian Xiaoyao Tang (Eight Immortals Free-Wandering Decoction, 八仙逍遙湯), and apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏) and blood-dispersing medicines, and it may be cured. If the second rib above is broken or crushed and pressed, collapsing and not rising, because its position is above the diaphragm, it is difficult to get a hand on it; even if one forces it, it is also difficult to make it whole. The blood injured there remains above the diaphragm, and if it does not move and disperse with the nature of the medicine, it must form a sac. If the sac is mild it contains yellow water; if hard it contains a blood clot, and then it becomes a chronic disease.
